snippet.title: For Evelyn II - Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
For Evelyn II: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248960/For_Evelyn_II__Shards_of_Creation/ 

Patreon backers will get immediate access.  https://www.patreon.com/TaleHammer 

Why Early Access?

“We believe that the best games are built alongside their communities. Launching in Early Access allows us to gather valuable feedback, test new ideas, and refine gameplay based on what players actually experience. By involving you early, we can ensure the final version of the game is more polished, balanced, and fun than it could ever be in isolation. Player input will directly shape the future of the game.”

Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?

“We plan to stay in Early Access for about 6–12 months, but we're committed to taking the time necessary to deliver a complete and polished experience. Depending on player feedback and the scope of additional features we decide to implement, this timeline may shift to ensure the final game meets both our standards and your expectations.”

How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?

“The full version is planned to expand on the foundation we're building during Early Access. We aim to add more content, including additional levels, features, gameplay mechanics, and improvements based on community feedback. We also intend to enhance performance, polish the visuals, and fine-tune the overall balance and quality of the game. Our goal is to deliver a richer, more complete experience that feels fully realized while staying true to the core vision players enjoy in Early Access.”

What is the current state of the Early Access version?

“The Early Access version is fully playable and includes the core gameplay mechanics, a selection of levels, and the foundational systems that define the experience. While it is stable and fun, players should expect that some features are still being refined, additional content is planned, and there may be occasional bugs or areas needing polish. Early Access is the beginning of a larger journey, and your feedback will be crucial as we continue to develop and improve the game.”

Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?

“We plan to increase the price as the game fully releases. Early Access players will get the game at a lower price as a thank you for supporting development and helping shape the final version.”

How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?

“Community feedback will be a key part of our development process. We'll be actively listening to player suggestions, bug reports, and balance feedback through forums, social media, and in-game surveys. Our goal is to create an open dialogue with players, sharing development updates regularly and using community input to help guide our priorities and improvements. Your ideas, experiences, and insights will directly help shape the future of the game.” 

Links: https://talehammer.carrd.co/ 
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TaleHammer 
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/talehammer.bsky.social

Voice Actors:
P.J. Kanis - Lord Maxwell
Caslei Goeller - Zhen-Rei
Lauren Kong - Lilith
Jalen Askins - Auron
Erin Lundquist - Iris Maxwell
